通用目标建议，加入后可按需编辑。: General suggestions you can edit after adding.

了解一个感兴趣的职业方向: Explore a career that interests you
查看岗位的工作内容与要求，记录感兴趣的部分和需要进一步了解的问题。: Review the role and its requirements. Note what interests you and what you want to learn more about.
选择一项与职业方向相关的技能，完成一个范围明确的练习，并保存练习成果。: Choose a relevant skill, complete a focused exercise and save your work.
整理本周学习与实践收获: Reflect on this week's learning and practice
回顾本周的学习和实践，记录收获、遇到的问题及下一步想尝试的行动。: Review your week and record what you learned, any challenges and what you would like to try next.
确定项目主题和交付内容，完成实践并整理过程、成果与本人贡献。: Define the project and deliverables, complete the work and document the process, results and your contribution.
比较两个感兴趣的职业方向: Compare two careers that interest you
对比日常工作、技能要求和个人偏好，记录选择依据与仍待验证的问题。: Compare daily work, required skills and personal preferences. Record your reasoning and open questions.
整理已有经历和成果，更新简历与作品集，检查描述是否与实际贡献一致。: Organize your experience and results, update your resume and portfolio, and check that descriptions match your contribution.
明确并验证职业发展方向: Define and test your career direction
结合职业探索与实际体验，逐步明确发展方向，并保留选择依据。: Use career exploration and practical experience to clarify your direction and record your reasoning.
完成职业方向探索\n通过实践验证兴趣\n复盘并调整发展方向:
Explore career options
Test your interests through practice
Review and adjust your direction
建立核心技能学习与实践计划: Build a plan to learn and practice core skills
围绕目标方向梳理技能差距，通过持续学习和实践积累可展示的成果。: Identify skill gaps for your chosen direction and build demonstrable results through learning and practice.
梳理核心技能与学习重点\n完成阶段性实践\n整理成果并复盘:
Identify core skills and learning priorities
Complete practice milestones
Organize results and reflect
积累一段与目标方向相关的实践经历: Gain practical experience in your chosen direction
寻找适合自己的项目或实习机会，记录工作过程、本人贡献与实践收获。: Find a suitable project or internship and document your work, contribution and learning.
确定实践方向\n完成一次相关实践\n整理经历与收获:
Choose a practice area
Complete relevant practical work
